headline: EVA Air Revenue Hits Record, P/E Just 9x! Large Holders with 1,000+ Lots Aggressively Buy 10% of Chips; High Oil Prices Eat Into Gross Profit
summary: EVA Air traded in a narrow range at NT$42.55 intraday, with volume of 8,545 lots. Its revenue reached a record, while high oil prices weigh on gross profit.
why: EVA Air is a Taiwanese airline whose costs are sensitive to jet fuel prices. Fuel costs and passenger demand drive its profitability.
